system.description:
A mercenary — mounted shooting, ambush tactics, knowing when to run.

  • Mounted Dead Eye: Dead Eye applies even while mounted — the horse's movement doesn't break the bonus.
  • Field Operator: Advantage on checks negotiating contracts, reading terrain for ambush positions, and identifying tracks.
